purpose: Parallel MPS STTN replication on the frozen multi-horizon splits; validation-selected checkpoint, test locked until all six runs finish
selection: mean validation MAE across all 12 horizons and three seeds; no test-driven changes
missing_policy: raw nonpositive or nonfinite is missing; observed normalized zero remains valid
historical_comparability: old 5-minute single-step results cannot be numerically compared as same task
notes: STGCN reference uses the inherited compact 8/16-channel architecture, not original-paper default width.
All STGCN factorial cells share a direct 12-output head; the recursive reference isolates that task adaptation.
PEMS-BAY models are independently trained on Bay train data; this is cross-dataset replication, not zero-shot transfer.
